data.sql: SELECT id,job_id,trigger_time,handle_time,trigger_code,handle_code,executor_param,handle_msg FROM lease_xxl_job_250.xxl_job_log WHERE job_id=38 AND trigger_time>='***' AND trigger_time<=NOW() ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10

arguments.sql: SELECT NOW() AS checked_at,COUNT(*) AS rows_count,COUNT(DISTINCT bill_no) AS distinct_bills,MIN(create_time) AS first_created,MAX(create_time) AS last_created,MIN(account_date) AS min_account_date,MAX(account_date) AS max_account_date FROM lease_saps.customer_bill_report WHERE create_time>='2026-11-13' AND create_time<=NOW() LIMIT 1

data.sql: SELECT NOW() AS checked_at,COUNT(*) AS rows_count,COUNT(DISTINCT bill_no) AS distinct_bills,MIN(create_time) AS first_created,MAX(create_time) AS last_created,MIN(account_date) AS min_account_date,MAX(account_date) AS max_account_date FROM lease_saps.customer_bill_report WHERE create_time>='***' AND create_time<=NOW() LIMIT 1

arguments.sql: SELECT b.product_type,COUNT(*) AS expected_bills,SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lease_saps.customer_bill_report r WHERE r.bill_no=b.bill_no)) AS covered FROM lease_saps.customer_bill b WHERE b.is_delete=0 AND b.is_cancel=0 GROUP BY b.product_type LIMIT 10

arguments.sql: SELECT b.product_type,COUNT(*) AS bills,SUM(r.overdue_fee) AS report_fee,SUM(f.fee_total) AS source_fee,SUM(CASE WHEN r.overdue_fee<>f.fee_total THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatch_count FROM lease_saps.customer_bill_report r JOIN lease_saps.customer_bill b ON b.bill_no=r.bill_no AND b.is_delete=0 JOIN (SELECT bill_no,SUM(total_amount) AS fee_total FROM lease_saps.bill_fee_detail WHERE subject_no IN ('10301','10302') AND is_delete=0 GROUP BY bill_no) f ON f.bill_no=r.bill_no WHERE r.create_time>='2026-11-13 14:49:00' GROUP BY b.product_type LIMIT 10

data.sql: SELECT b.product_type,COUNT(*) AS bills,SUM(r.overdue_fee) AS report_fee,SUM(f.fee_total) AS source_fee,SUM(CASE WHEN r.overdue_fee<>f.fee_total THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatch_count FROM lease_saps.customer_bill_report r JOIN lease_saps.customer_bill b ON b.bill_no=r.bill_no AND b.is_delete=0 JOIN (SELECT bill_no,SUM(total_amount) AS fee_total FROM lease_saps.bill_fee_detail WHERE subject_no IN ('***','***') AND is_delete=0 GROUP BY bill_no) f ON f.bill_no=r.bill_no WHERE r.create_time>='***' GROUP BY b.product_type LIMIT 10

arguments.sql: SELECT b.product_type,COUNT(*) AS affected_bills,SUM(r.bill_no IS NOT NULL) AS report_covered,SUM(t.fee_amount) AS new_fee FROM (SELECT bill_no,SUM(fee_amount) AS fee_amount FROM lease_saps.bill_fee_record WHERE end_date IN ('2026-11-12','2026-11-13') AND is_delete=0 GROUP BY bill_no) t JOIN lease_saps.customer_bill b ON b.bill_no=t.bill_no AND b.is_delete=0 LEFT JOIN lease_saps.customer_bill_report r ON r.bill_no=b.bill_no GROUP BY b.product_type LIMIT 10

data.sql: SELECT b.product_type,COUNT(*) AS affected_bills,SUM(r.bill_no IS NOT NULL) AS report_covered,SUM(t.fee_amount) AS new_fee FROM (SELECT bill_no,SUM(fee_amount) AS fee_amount FROM lease_saps.bill_fee_record WHERE end_date IN ('***','***') AND is_delete=0 GROUP BY bill_no) t JOIN lease_saps.customer_bill b ON b.bill_no=t.bill_no AND b.is_delete=0 LEFT JOIN lease_saps.customer_bill_report r ON r.bill_no=b.bill_no GROUP BY b.product_type LIMIT 10
